---
title: "Inferring a phylogeny of the *Anolis distichus* species group with `IQ-TREE2`"
author: "Tanner Myers"
output:
    html_document:
        toc: TRUE
---

To obtain an estimate of relationships among the 297 samples in our dataset, I am using the RAD loci with SNPs used for the 90% complete SNP dataset used for population genomics analyses. To get the full RADtags for those loci, with both invariant and variant sites, I am making a whitelist of the loci included and using the `populations` module of `Stacks` to extract those loci.

## Make "whitelist" of RAD loci
```{r, eval = F}
library(vcfR)

## read in VCF filtered and pruned for physical linkage
vcfR <- read.vcfR("/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/full_miss90_LD.vcf")

## check out metadata
head(vcfR@fix)

## isolate the third column, which contains the name of each locus
head(vcfR@fix[,3])

## get list of just locus names to use as whitelist for stacks
whitelist <- sub(":.*", "", vcfR@fix[,3])

## make sure the locus names look right
whitelist[1:5]

### write out whitelist for stacks
write.table(whitelist, file = "/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/fullmiss90LD_snps.txt", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F)
```

## Run populations 
```{bash, eval=F}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=brev-stacks
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=10
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=12gb
#SBATCH --time=1:00:00
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --error=err.pops_%j
#SBATCH --output=out.pops_%j

module load stacks/2.61

POPMAP=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/filtered-specimens.txt
CAT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/gstacks
OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/phylo
LIST=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/fullmiss90LD_snps.txt

# Run populations to get full RAD tags with invariant sites
populations -P $CAT_DIR -M $POPMAP -O $OUT_DIR -W $LIST -t 10 --phylip-var-all --vcf-all
```

Run `grep -v "^#" populations.all.phylip > tmp && mv tmp populations.all.phylip`.

## Estimate concatenated RAD loci phylogeny
```{bash, eval=F}
#! /usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --partition jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem 12G
#SBATCH --time 24:00:00
#SBATCH --output out.concatTree_%j
#SBATCH --error err.concatTree_%j

source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate phyloenv

MSA=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/phylo/populations.all.phylip

cd /scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/phylo/iq-tree/concat_miss90LD

### Run IQ-TREE2
iqtree -s $MSA -m MFP -B 1000 --alrt 1000 -st DNA -seed 1968 -nt AUTO --prefix concat_miss90LD
```

```{r, fig.width = 24, fig.height = 24}
tree <- read.tree("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/phylo/iqtree-concat/concat_miss90LD.treefile")
tree$tip.label <- str_split(tree$tip.label, pattern = "\\.", simplify = T)[,1]
tree$tip.label %in% popmap$specimen

popmap <- popmap[match(tree$tip.label, popmap$specimen),]
tree$taxon <- popmap$population_post
tree$tip.label <- paste(tree$tip.label, tree$taxon, popmap$locality, sep = "_")

tree2 <- midpoint(tree)
plot(tree2, show.node.label = TRUE)
```

```{r, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 18}
library(ggtree)
library(tidytree)
library(ggnewscale)

# Parse the support values
parse_support <- function(label) {
  if (is.na(label) || label == "") return(c(NA, NA))
    parts <- strsplit(as.character(label), "/")[[1]]
    shalrt <- as.numeric(parts[1])
    ufboot <- as.numeric(parts[2])
    return(c(shalrt, ufboot))
}
# Extract UFboot and SH-aLRT values
support_values <- t(sapply(tree2$node.label, parse_support))
shalrt <- support_values[, 1]
ufboot <- support_values[, 2]

# Replace labels with NA where BOTH values exceed thresholds
tree2$node.label <- ifelse(shalrt >= 80 & ufboot >= 95, 
                           "supported", 
                           tree2$node.label)

p <- ggtree(tree2) +
        geom_tiplab(size = 4, family = "Helvetica", offset = 0.0001) +
        geom_point2(aes(subset = !isTip & label == "supported"),
                size  = 2,
                color = "black",
                shape = 16) + # filled circle
        # geom_nodelab(aes(subset = !isTip),
        # size = 2,
        # hjust = -0.2,
        # color = "gray40") +
        # geom_text(aes(label = node), size = 2, color = "blue") + # Show node labels for mapping
        geom_tippoint(aes(color = label), size = 5) +
        scale_color_manual(values = tip_colors) +
        theme(legend.position = "none",
                axis.line.x = element_blank(),
                axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
        hexpand(.3)
p
ggsave(filename = "~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/concatenated-90completeLD-ML-tree.pdf",
        limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 300, width = 16, height = 40)

# p %>% collapse(node = 314, "min", fill = "#662822")
clade_info <- tibble(
        node  = c(332, 319, 315, 326,
                329, 323, 453, 425,
                384, 516, 562, 558,
                542, 586, 589, 300,
                422, 421, 424, 578),
        label = c("A. d. dominicensis - E", "A. d. distichoides", "A. d. biminiensis", "A. d. dapsilis",
                "A. d. ocior",  "A. d. distichus", "A. d. ignigularis - W", "A. d. ravitergum",
                "A. brevirostris", "A. d. sejunctus", "A. d. favillarum", "A. d. dominicensis - NW",
                "A. d. dominicensis - W", "A. d. vinosus", "A. d. suppar", "A. d. aurifer",
                "A. marron", "A. caudalis", "A. websteri", "A. d. dominicensis - SW"),  # clade names
  fill  = cols[c("dominicensis_E", "distichoides", "biminiensis", "dapsilis",
                "ocior", "distichus", "west_ignigularis", "ravitergum",
                "brevirostris", "sejunctus", "favillarum", "dominicensis_NW",
                "dominicensis_W", "vinosus", "suppar", "aurifer",
                "marron", "caudalis", "websteri", "dominicensis_SW")]  # matched colors
)

# Uncollapsed taxa info
uncollapsed_info <- tibble(
  node  = c(494, 475),  # replace with actual node numbers
  label = c("A. d. properus", "A. d. ignigularis - E"),
  fill  = cols[c("properus", "east_ignigularis")]
)

# Collapse all clades iteratively
p_collapsed <- ggtree(tree2, branch.length = "none")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(clade_info))) {
  p_collapsed <- collapse(p_collapsed,
                           node  = clade_info$node[i],
                           mode  = "mixed",
                           fill  = clade_info$fill[i],
                           alpha = 0.8)
}

# Add clade labels and bootstrap support on remaining nodes
p_collapsed +
        geom_tippoint(aes(color = label), size = 2) +
        # geom_tiplab(aes(color = label),
        #         size = 2,
        #         offset = 0.1,
        #         fontface = "italic") +
        scale_color_manual(values = tip_colors) +
        new_scale_color() +
geom_cladelab(data = clade_info,
        mapping = aes(node = node,
                label = label,
                color = fill),
                fontsize = 5,
                fontface = "italic",
                offset = 0.05,
                offset.text = 0.1,
                align = TRUE,
                barsize = 0.5) +
geom_cladelab(data = uncollapsed_info,
        mapping = aes(node = node,
                label = label,
                color = fill),
                fontsize = 5,
                fontface = "italic",
                offset = 0.05,
                offset.text = 0.1,
                align = FALSE,
                barsize = 0,
                barcolour = NA) +
scale_color_identity() +
# geom_nodelab(aes(subset = !isTip),
#         size = 2,
#         hjust = -0.2,
#         color = "gray40") +
theme_tree() +
theme(legend.position = "none") +
hexpand(.3)
ggsave(filename = "~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/figures/concatenated-90completeLD-ML-tree-collapsed.pdf",
        limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 300)
```
